_description: Frozen trajectories.json schema — Day 7. Data contract for Block C (Day 10).
_fixes_applied: Fragment filter missing for short tracks
FPS extraction method not specified in ingestor
_corrections_applied: Correction C: velocity_norm embedded for Block C F2 feature
Correction schema-accuracy: conf is never null in Day 7 SORT output

_day7_behaviour_notes.raw_only: Day 7 saves RAW trajectories. Fragment filter (min_track_length=15) is not applied yet; Day 9 writes a filtered artifact separately.
_day7_behaviour_notes.conf_null_clarification: In Day 7 SORT output, conf is NEVER null. The SORT tracker only emits a track when time_since_update < 1, so every emitted track frame corresponds to a matched detection with a real confidence score. Prediction-only states are not written in Day 7 SORT.
_day7_behaviour_notes.nms_thresh_provenance: nms_thresh is stored in config_blockB.yaml for provenance only. It is NOT active in Day 7 because cached detections from Block A are already post-NMS.
_day7_behaviour_notes.split_source: Sequence lists come from frozen split_manifest.json via split_utils.py, not clips_master.txt. split_blockABC_*.txt are frozen companion artifacts.

detector: string — frozen from Day 6 Block A selection; reflected as selected==True in logs/block_a/block_a_results.csv
warmup_boundary: int — 0-based frame_idx; frames <= this excluded during evaluation and later feature extraction (Fix F16)
fps: float — sequence FPS from the frozen metadata source established in earlier stages (Fix F20)
frame_diagonal: float — sqrt(W^2 + H^2), denominator for dist_norm in Block C
min_track_length: int — stored for Day 9 reference; NOT applied in this file

<track_id_string>.frame_idx: int — 0-based, matches cache contract (Fix F12). GT is 1-based; offset is applied only in evaluation, never in saved trajectories.
<track_id_string>.velocity_norm: float or null — null only for the first appearance of a track. Thereafter: dist(centroid_t, centroid_{t-1}) * fps / frame_diagonal. Do not replace null with 0.
<track_id_string>.conf: float — detection confidence from cache. In Day 7 SORT output this is always a float.

_block_c_data_contract.F1_density: frame_idx — for windowed vehicle count and ROI occupancy
_block_c_data_contract.F2_speed: velocity_norm — already normalised by fps and frame_diagonal
_block_c_data_contract.F3_distance: cx, cy, frame_diagonal — inter-vehicle distance computed in Block C
